key_insight: Bi-FORK learns one-to-many solution maps for symmetry-breaking bifurcations, generating multiple valid high-dimensional trajectories from a single input.
engineering_relevance: This enables scalable surrogate modeling for physical systems where a single condition can lead to distinct outcomes, such as buckling, metamaterials, and phase separation.
method: Latent flow matching generates full space-time trajectories with coherence preserved.
Repulsion-guided sampling encourages distinct branches to appear in one amortized inference pass.
Designed for high-dimensional bifurcating systems with continuous, discrete, and field-valued outputs.
evidence_signal: The paper evaluates Bi-FORK on buckling beams, mechanical metamaterials, and Allen-Cahn phase separation, with discretizations up to 260,000 points, and reports recovery of multimodal solution structure at much larger scale than prior methods.
watch_item: Repulsion-guided branch separation may be sensitive to sampling and hyperparameter choices when solution modes are closely spaced or weakly distinct.
paper_title: Bi-FORK: Generative Modeling of High-Dimensional Bifurcating Systems
